title: Save-and-return contract: a server-side draft table or a client-side local buffer with a sync tick; refuses to ship if neither is wired
description: The wizard commits partial answers between steps to a draft store so an operator can leave the surface and return without losing progress. Two transports ship: a server-side draft table (POST /drafts persists per-operator per-wizard rows, GET /drafts hydrates on return) and a client-side local buffer (localStorage keyed by operator identifier and wizard slug with a per-write sync tick). ADR-2502 commits to no recommendedDefault because the abandoned-draft loss class is genuinely per-project. A wizard that ships without either transport is refused at build gate: the draft-store TAC is a required companion. Per WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.7 Redundant Entry: information the operator has already entered is preserved across sessions and not re-solicited.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.3, REQ 5.
